channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 4 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Andy Warhol Foundation: Exhibition Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/exhibition-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000. Direct costs only (artist payments, catalogue and publication, artist-designed public programmes); staff salaries excluded. Request must not exceed 25 percent of total direct project costs, which functions as a de facto 75 percent co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Multi-year Program Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/multi-year-program-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent cap means the balance must come from elsewhere. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/project-grants-for-small-scale-organizations/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
  • Pandora Short Film Grant 2026
    https://pandora.org/
    Pandora Short Film Grant · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $12,000 production grant to the winner, plus a Panavision camera package (worth about $15,000), an optional $1,000 Kodak Film Grant toward film stock and lab expenses, mentorship from an award-winning filmmaker, and fiscal sponsorship. Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance. ENTRY FEE: tiered, $30 regular ($27 Gold members) and $40 late ($36); Pandora states fee waivers are available on request.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Westonka Public Artwork Commissions (Hennepin County Library, Mound, MN)
    https://forecastpublicart.org/westonka-library
    Hennepin County Library, facilitated by Forecast Public Art · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · Two commissions (artists/teams may apply to one only). Opportunity 1 (Commerce Porch): $60,000 not-to-exceed artist fee. Opportunity 2 (Concrete Shear Wall + Trash Enclosure mural): $75,000 not-to-exceed artist fee. Each fee covers all expenses (artist time, equipment, materials, community engagement, fabrication, installation and any other project costs). No application fee.
  • A3 Art Alliance Austin: 2026-27 Micro-Grants
    https://a3austin.org/2026-27-micro-grants/
    A3 Art Alliance Austin · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Two non-restrictive tiers: $1,000 Individual Artist Micro-Grants (for artist educators and emerging visual artists working toward their first major exhibitions), and $2,000 Community Organization Micro-Grants (for producing organizations with an annual budget under $500,000 providing free public arts programming in the Austin area). Funds can be used at the recipient's discretion. No application fee.
  • WeHo Artist Grant 2027 (City of West Hollywood)
    https://form.jotform.com/260207043310136
    City of West Hollywood, Arts Division · deadline Closed 01 Jul 2026 · $6,000 per artist (total category pool of $30,000/year, so approximately 5 awards). Funds may be used in any capacity to fulfil the proposed project within the calendar year. No application fee.
